model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across different language families for six model variants. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains nine categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 30. Each language family group contains up to six bars representing different model configurations, as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink/salmon), and XLM-B₂ (red). Each bar includes error bars indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all bars are relatively small, ranging from roughly 1 to 5. IE-Germanic shows bars around 0 to 15, with XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 15. IE-Indic displays the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 24 and XLM-B₂ around 21, while mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ are around 18 and 17 respectively. IE-Romance bars range from roughly 1 to 13. IE-Slavic shows values from about 5 to 17, with XLM-B₂ being the tallest at approximately 17. IE-other has bars ranging from about 5 to 8. Isolate shows very small bars near 0 with minimal variation. Semitic displays notable variation, with mBERT-L₂ around 11 and some bars (mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂) appearing slightly negative, near -1 to -2, while XLM-B₂ reaches approximately 20 with large error bars. Uralic bars are mostly near 0, with XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 19 but accompanied by very large error bars extending well above 30. The bars within each group are arranged consistently in the order listed in the legend from left to right, and the B₂ variants (pink and red) generally appear to have the tallest bars across most families. Several bars, particularly in the Semitic and Uralic categories, feature notably large error bars suggesting high uncertainty.
